_comment: Authoritative pointer to the current primary checkpoint. Update this in the same commit that promotes a model, never separately. Superseded entries move to `history` and their archive refs are never deleted.

current.label: core-v0.2.1-r002

benchmark.name: Core-Bench
benchmark.decode: greedy, temperature 0, top_p 1.0, top_k off, repetition_penalty 1.0, max_new_tokens 20

training.stage1: configs/train/core_stage1_7m.yaml (1000 steps, real dialogue, loss on all tokens)
training.corpus: 60k Core curriculum + 4k real conversations truncated to 6 turns

current.promotion_rationale: Higher Core-Bench (0.629 vs 0.594) AND preferred in a manual side-by-side conversational test. Model B held a topic across turns more consistently than r001 despite rougher surface grammar. For the current objective -- semantic correctness and conversational action selection before stylistic polish -- that is the more valuable failure mode.

history.label: core-v0.2.1-r001
history.note: First checkpoint that sustained a short exchange. Better surface grammar than r002, weaker semantic continuity.

history.label: v0.1-pre-core
history.note: Diversity-optimised line, before the v0.2-Core reliability rework. No Core-Bench.
